title: OpenAI Just Gave Every Team A Free Employee. Here's The Catch.
summary: The article discusses the deployment of OpenAI's agentic tools as a form of virtual employee augmentation for business teams. It examines the practical implications and limitations of integrating these autonomous systems into organizational workflows.

title: Microsoft and OpenAI end their exclusive and revenue-sharing deal
summary: Microsoft and OpenAI have formally terminated their exclusive revenue-sharing agreement, marking a significant shift in their long-standing partnership. This change suggests a restructuring of their operational relationship as OpenAI transitions toward a more independent business model.

title: Show HN: OSS Agent I built topped the TerminalBench on Gemini-3-flash-preview
summary: The author developed an open-source agent that achieved top performance on TerminalBench using Google's Gemini-3-flash-preview model. The project demonstrates the viability of utilizing lightweight, fast models for complex command-line interaction tasks.

title: Mistral built a $14B AI empire by not being American
summary: Mistral AI has achieved a $14 billion valuation by positioning itself as a European alternative to US-centric AI companies. The company leverages open-weight models and regional regulatory alignment to capture market share within the EU.

title: Running local LLMs offline on a ten-hour flight
summary: This article discusses the practical application of running large language models locally on consumer hardware without an active internet connection. It highlights the feasibility of utilizing quantized models to maintain LLM utility during long-duration travel where cloud connectivity is unavailable.

title: EvanFlow – A TDD driven feedback loop for Claude Code
summary: EvanFlow is a development workflow utility designed to integrate Test Driven Development (TDD) principles directly into the Claude Code agentic environment. It establishes an iterative feedback loop that allows the AI to autonomously write, execute, and refine code based on test case results.
